- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lower Saxony is a state in northwestern Germany with many local festivals that have different cultural and historical backgrounds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Costumes worn during festivals in Lower Saxony reflect local traditions and customs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] During the Schützenfest festival, people wear traditional garments from the 18th and 19th centuries, such as frock coats, top hats, and sashes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The costumes symbolize the historical roots of the Schützenfest, which was originally a celebration of military marksmanship.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Costumes worn during festivals in Lower Saxony help preserve and honor the cultural heritage of the region.
- [USER] User expressed interest in the information provided and asked about other festivals in Lower Saxony with unique costumes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carnival (Karneval) is a major event in Lower Saxony where people wear colorful and elaborate costumes featuring masks, feathers, sequins, and other adornments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Erntefest (Harvest Festival) features costumes with fruits, vegetables, and other symbols of the harvest.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Krampuslauf is a pre-Christmas tradition where people dress up as the Krampus, a demonic creature from folklore.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Each festival has its own cultural and historical significance, and the costumes help celebrate and preserve these traditions.
